There is no limit on the percentage of common area expenditures that may be applied to an individual tenant. However, a specific common area expenditure may not be applied to more than one tenant. Expenditures on common areas can be claimed no earlier than three years before the lease commencement date.

Can you apply for benefits if a lease has an "out-clause" (voided under certain circumstances)? An eligible lease may not have an early-out clause within the CRP benefit period by either the landlord or tenant.
